entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

The issue is they're destroying my feet! I've moved the cleats around a dozen times, followed all your guides, and all I get are massive blisters on my heels. I can't even finish a ride! I paid a premium for these and I expect a premium product, not a torture device.
That sounds incredibly painful and frustrating. Getting blisters like that would definitely ruin a ride. Let me pull up your account information. Can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Mark Peterson. The order number is VF-8675309. Look, I don't want to troubleshoot, I don't want a different size. I want a full refund, and I want it now. If you can't do that, get me your manager, because I'm about to leave a review on every cycling forum on the internet about this.

I understand your frustration, Mark, and I'll do my best to resolve this for you right now. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see the order for the Road Cycling Shoes, delivered 67 days ago.
So? What's your point? Are you going to help me or not?
Yes, absolutely. According to our return policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you immediately.
Oh. You can? Just like that? A full refund?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return authorization in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop the package off. As soon as it's scanned at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Okay. Well... good. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mark. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
